, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the first place named in Esther (NIV) as “Susa,” whereas Esther 1:1 first mentions “India” (before “Cush” and before “Susa” in v.2). This led the team to select Iran and its PM (Amir-Abbas Hoveyda) instead of India and its PM (Morarji Desai) for April 1977.
